links.effect: SafeNET applied unmodified locally gave AUC-ROC 0.87, F1 0.73, Brier 0.055, close to published performance despite extensive missingness.
links.quote: These findings indicate that SafeNET maintained predictive performance for in-hospital mortality comparable to its originally reported results, despite substantial dataset shift and extensive missingness in our real-world EHR data.

links.outcome: Performance of locally retrained models versus the unmodified external model (AUC, F1, Brier)
links.effect: Local CatBoost outperformed SafeNET: in-hospital AUC-ROC 0.92 vs 0.87, Brier 0.04 vs 0.055; better calibration across 30-day and 90-day too.
links.quote: Locally trained gradient-boosting models outperformed SafeNET in predicting the primary outcome across all major evaluation domains, demonstrating higher discrimination, stronger F1 scores, and superior calibration.

links.outcome: Availability of model input variables in local production EHR data
links.effect: Functional status measures were missing in 91.3% and comorbidity indicators in 96-99% of encounters; vitals and labs 42-43% missing, limiting the original feature set.
links.quote: Substantial missingness was observed across several SafeNET predictors: Vital signs and laboratory values showed 42–43% missingness, while functional status measures (91.3%) and comorbidity indicators (96–99%) were missing in the majority of cases.

links.outcome: Dataset shift between development and local setting and its effect on performance
links.effect: Despite substantial differences in patient mix, data pipelines and documentation, SafeNET performed comparably (AUC 0.87), but local models did better, showing site-specific patterns matter.
links.quote: Despite substantial differences in patient mix, data pipelines, and documentation practices, and high rates of missingness, SafeNET performed comparably to its development-site results, suggesting that its core predictor set generalizes well across health systems.

links.outcome: Precision-recall trade-off implying false-alarm burden at operating threshold
links.effect: Recall was at least 0.70 in most configurations but precision remained below 0.70 in several settings, indicating many false positives even in top models.
links.quote: However, precision remained less than 0.70 in several settings, reflecting a notable rate of false positives.
